semantic.justification: Original SmartRel2Abs leading-fragment compatibility, invalid-base smart parsing, valid-base relative conversion, optional non-file preference and maybe-file callback selection. The source callback local OUString pointer is represented by a mutable single-string slot; no browser URL/OS filesystem resolver or fabricated Link service replaces the native algorithm. All original defaults are retained, including checkFileExists=true; actual HTML caller is expected to pass null/false. Complete URIHelper factory/context/other services and native Link ABI are outside this consumed slice. Native full-class differential and actual HTML HREF insertion remain pending.
